learning_outcomes.text: Acquire an engineering knowledge of hydraulic drive systems, widely known as Fluid Power Systems.
Acquire theoretical and practical expertise in mechanical actuation systems with fluid as an internal energy vector, to identify shapes and characteristics of the machines.
Acquire knowledge of fluid machinery components and their operation, with a focus on displacement pumps, actuators, and valves, and also on the systems arrangement.
Acquire knowledge of basic and advanced architectures for industrial and mobile applications, operating principles, standards, and key design parameters of fluid power systems.

syllabus_topics: Other Control Valves and Basic Hydraulic/Pneumatic Circuits
Seminars on Vehicular Applications of Fluid Power
assessment_rules: Assessment is expressed on a 30-point scale. To pass, students must demonstrate adequate knowledge of fundamental concepts, ability to apply them, and command of technical language. Higher marks are awarded for full understanding, ability to connect content, accuracy in representation, and autonomy in analysis. Failure may result from insufficient knowledge, significant errors, or limited technical terminology command.
